import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['canopy_cover','soil_moisture','elevation_m','road_dist_km','leaf_litter','temperature_c','slope_deg','nitrate','grazing_index','rainfall_mm']
d = df.dropna(subset=['species_richness']+exposures).copy()
print("n used", len(d))
for e in exposures:
    X = pd.get_dummies(d[['region']], drop_first=True).astype(float)
    X['exp'] = d[e].values
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    m = sm.OLS(d['species_richness'].values, X).fit()
    print(f"{e:15s} beta={m.params['exp']:8.4f} se={m.bse['exp']:.4f} t={m.tvalues['exp']:7.3f} p={m.pvalues['exp']:.4f}")
